scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire as dropCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = dropCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" && cp node_modules/@resvg/resvg-wasm/index_bg.wasm dist/resvg.wasm && cp node_modules/@jsquash/webp/codec/dec/webp_dec.wasm dist/webp_dec.wasm
